whyExactArtifactChanged: hybrid-admission.ts copies verification fields into facts with {...v}; certified structured facts also retain issuer metadata. retainedReaderProof is never consulted by validVerification. All sourceBindings are copied into content and contentHash. Removing reader proof changes metadata, not accounting facts; pruning359 extraction bindings changes snapshot identity. No formula or acceptance rule changed.
